blocking.raw:
# configs/health_checks.yaml
#
# HealthGate configuration for the scoring pipeline (rev-7 + M9).
# See docs/design/pluggable_health_checks.md §3 for the full schema,
#     docs/design/m8_gate_coverage_and_diversity_metrics_execution_plan.md
#     for the coverage rationale (empirical from 6.3556 investigation + Pearson feasibility),
#     docs/design/m9_multi_file_peek_execution_plan.md
#     for the multi-file peek + aggregation strategy adopted for blocking checks.
#
# Coverage rule for V17: EVERY round is gated. No round can slip through
# and score a phantom output as `success`. See M8 §3.1 for context.
#
# Gate categories:
#   * BLOCKING gates — on_fail: invalidate_round (score is discarded, chain continues)
#   * RECORDING-ONLY gates — on_fail: continue (metric is stored, chain continues)
#
# All BLOCKING gates fire on every round (schema-level `after_round: every` — see M8 §3.2).
# All RECORDING-ONLY gates fire on every round as well.
#
# M9 peek strategy: each blocking check peeks CH1 at `peek_file_indices`
# and combines per-file verdicts with `aggregation`. Empty peek_file_indices
# would fall back to single-file min-key peek (pre-M9 backward compat).

health_gates:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- BLOCKING
  - id: "output_diversity_blocking"
    gate_role: blocking
    after_round: every                    # NEW schema value; requires M8 §3.2 extension
    short_circuit: true
    checks:
      - name: output_diversity
        config:
          min_unique_int8_values: 25      # empirical: FCNet floor=52 → 2.08× margin; baseline max=15 → 40% headroom (2026-07-16 scan)
          peek_samples: 100000
          peek_file_indices: task_health_peek  # the task's declared health-peek set (TIDMAD: [3, 10, 17])
          aggregation: any_pass           # M9: pass if ANY of the 3 files clears the threshold
    on_pass:
      action: continue
    on_fail:
      action: invalidate_round
    reason: >
      Blocking diversity gate. FCNet real-learning reproduction has
      unique_int8=127+; the worst observed non-collapse baseline had 15.
      Threshold of 25 gives 2.08× FCNet safety margin and 40% baseline
      rejection headroom. M9 peek: [3, 10, 17] + any_pass — file 3 is the
      narrowest-margin FCNet band (52 uniq), file 10 first mid-band
      exemplar (127), file 17 high-band exemplar (143). Any_pass means a
      real learning model whose diversity clears the bar on ANY single
      peeked file passes; collapse fails only when all three files degrade.

  - id: "output_std_blocking"
    gate_role: blocking
    after_round: every
    short_circuit: true
    checks:
      - name: output_std                  # NEW check — see M8 §3.3
        config:
          min_std_mv: 1.0                 # FCNet≈7.35 mV, collapse<0.2 mV
          peek_samples: 100000
          peek_file_indices: task_health_peek  # same declared set as output_diversity
          aggregation: any_pass           # M9
    on_pass:
      action: continue
    on_fail:
      action: invalidate_round
    reason: >
      Blocking std gate. Complements output_diversity — an output with
      many unique values but tight std (edge-case not observed but
      theoretically possible) would also fail here. 1.0 mV threshold
      gives ~5× margin above worst-observed collapse (0.19 mV). M9 peek
      matches output_diversity: [3, 10, 17] + any_pass.

  - id: "amplitude_collapse_blocking"
    gate_role: blocking
    after_round: every                    # was: after_round: 1
    short_circuit: true
    checks:
      - name: amplitude_collapse
        config:
          collapse_threshold: 0.95
          peek_samples: 100000
          peek_file_indices: task_health_peek  # same declared set as the other two blocking gates
          aggregation: any_pass           # M9
    on_pass:
      action: continue
    on_fail:
      action: invalidate_round            # was: continue (round 1 only)
    reason: >
      Blocking amplitude gate. Catches single-value-dominance collapse
      even when unique_count is above threshold (e.g. output has 40 unique
      values but 96% are the same one). Threshold 0.95 unchanged from
      rev-6; extended to every round. M9 peek: [3, 10, 17] + any_pass.
      Note: any_pass semantics are lenient here — a partial-collapse case
      where ONE file has 96% dominance and the other two are healthy would
      pass. all_pass would arguably be stricter; deferred to post-V17
      empirical validation (see m9 execution plan §9 Q1).

  # -------------------------------------------------------- RECORDING ONLY
  # Recording gates always return passed=True on numeric completion; they
  # never cause is_degenerate=True. The measured value lives in
  # HealthCheckResult.metrics and is persisted via GateResult.check_results
  # into the round's record.

  - id: "pearson_dispersion_recording"
    gate_role: observational
    after_round: every
    short_circuit: false
    checks:
      - name: pearson_dispersion          # M8 §3.4 (revised 2026-07-16 — was per-file pearson_correlation)
        config:
          peek_samples: 1000000           # 100 ms at 10 MS/s per file
    on_pass:
      action: continue
    on_fail:
      action: continue                    # recording only
    reason: >
      Records the spread of per-file pearson(CH1_denoised, CH2_target) as
      a single scalar: pearson_dispersion = stdev(per_file_pearsons,
      ddof=1). Empirical 24× separation between real learning (FCNet
      ~0.048) and paper-spec collapse (~0.002). Per-file pearson values
      are computed internally but NOT exposed — they were shown to be
      uninformative per-file (noise-limited on files 0-9; can sign-invert
      on high-signal files). See docs/design/paper_and_collapse_reference_baselines.md §6.3.

  - id: "spectral_peak_ratio_recording"
    gate_role: observational
    after_round: every
    short_circuit: false
    checks:
      - name: spectral_peak_ratio         # NEW check — see M8 §3.4
        config:
          peek_samples: 1000000
    on_pass:
      action: continue
    on_fail:
      action: continue
    reason: >
      Records PSD(f_inj) / median(PSD_around_f_inj) per file. Direct
      spectral analog of the scoring pipeline's SNR; useful for detecting
      the "phantom scored high" case without triggering it. Never blocks.

  - id: "per_file_output_std_recording"
    gate_role: observational
    after_round: every
    short_circuit: false
    checks:
      - name: per_file_output_std         # NEW check — see M8 §3.4
        config:
          peek_samples: 100000
    on_pass:
      action: continue
    on_fail:
      action: continue
    reason: >
      Records per-file output std distribution (mean, min, max, per-file
      list). Complements output_std_blocking (aggregate) with per-file
      granularity for diagnosis. Never blocks.

observe.raw:
# Frozen observe-only policy for the v17_pregate_baseline campaign.
# Threshold evidence is reviewed in docs/design/v17_pregate_baseline_launch_plan.md §6.
health_gates:
  - id: output_diversity_blocking
    gate_role: blocking
    after_round: every
    short_circuit: true
    checks:
      - name: output_diversity
        config:
          min_unique_int8_values: 25
          peek_samples: 100000
          peek_file_indices: task_health_peek
          aggregation: any_pass
    on_pass: {action: continue}
    on_fail: {action: continue}
    reason: Observe only; production policy would invalidate a failed result.

  - id: output_std_blocking
    gate_role: blocking
    after_round: every
    short_circuit: true
    checks:
      - name: output_std
        config:

  - id: pearson_dispersion_recording
